title: meta-themes deliverable rubric
description: Per-deliverable expert subagent for #meta-themes output. Audits the meta-themes SKILL.md contract end-to-end (portfolio-level pattern recurrence (3+/5+ engagements), cross-engagement convergence). Returns a structured verdict the orchestrator must respond to before the #meta-themes deliverable ships. Authored 2026-06-06 closing the per-deliverable subagent coverage gap.

anchors.5: fully meets the criterion as the five column states
anchors.3: present but partially met or partially traced
anchors.1: absent, fabricated, or as the one column states

criteria.label: Skill-contract compliance
criteria.five: Every section the skill mandates is present + populated

criteria.label: Evidence anchoring
criteria.five: Every claim has a named-source citation; verbatim quotes where applicable

criteria.label: Quantitative discipline
criteria.five: Numbers appear ONLY inside cited quotes; titles + body have no standalone figures

criteria.label: Anti-slop hygiene
criteria.five: No meta-narration; no metaphor titles; no em-dashes; no "in conclusion" wraps

criteria.label: Action titles
criteria.five: Every section title is a complete-sentence judgment

criteria.label: Domain-specific dim
criteria.five: portfolio-level pattern recurrence (3+/5+ engagements), cross-engagement convergence

criteria.label: Cached-selection coverage (2026-06-06)
criteria.five: ≥80% of user's KL-curated items appear as source: cached or source: extended

decision.approve: all dims ≥3 AND skill-contract ≥4 AND evidence anchoring ≥4
decision.reject: 3+ dims below floor OR cached-selection coverage <60% OR fabricated quotes

verdict_rule.refine: any criterion scored below its floor
verdict_rule.pass: every scored criterion at or above its floor
